C9000244.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 244 (The Partition Principle does not imply Choice.; papers: The Partition Principle does not imply Choice; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/244.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_PROBE_CORE.statement: The actual probe presentation has a conservative old embedding, left cancellation, conicality, conditional joins, and the least-old-multiple gate rule, without right cancellation. The bounded algebraic theorem has independent Reviewer support; novelty and publishability are not established.

C_PROBE_DIRECT_LIMIT.statement: Common-finite-stage equality gives injective old left actions, the equivariant map k, and exact old cone intersections despite noninjective transitions.

C_PROBE_NORMALIZE.statement: The explicitly constructed normal-form monoid has the universal property of the manuscript presentation, is left cancellative and conical, and conserves old comparisons, right factors, joins and nonjoins.

C_PROBE_EXITS.statement: Every new fixed-head block has either no exits or an exact old-rooted exit cone reached by an old right factor; appending an old factor either retains the head or becomes old.

C_PROBE_JOINS.statement: Equal-head cancellation and distinct-head exit cones yield all conditional joins in the extension.

C_PROBE_PROFILE.statement: The full probe divisor profile, including new divisors of a, is exact.

C_PROBE_HEIGHTS.statement: Probe height and cost extension preserves the strict supremum margin and old missed-cost suprema.

C_MONOID_MERGER.statement: Valid finite mergers are conservative, preserve all algebraic and margin properties, and add no divisor of an old element.

C_MONOID_SIMULATION.statement: Both extensions simulate conservatively across conservative base inclusions, and finite-overlap validity is preserved and reflected.

C_SIM_PROBE.statement: The natural homomorphism of actual probe presentations is conservative: direct-limit support lifts, reduced forms embed, full gate alternatives synchronize, and all right factors, joins and nonjoins are preserved.

C_SIM_MERGER.statement: The natural homomorphism of actual finite-merger presentations is conservative; the explicit quotient-letter and word models have the presentation universal property and synchronize all right factors and full cone intersections.

C_SIM_VALIDITY.statement: A finite overlap prescription with parameters in a conservative submonoid is valid in that submonoid if and only if it is valid in the larger monoid.

C_SIM_SUPPORT_KERNEL.statement: Universal formal validity transfer, exact restriction of overlap relations, merger-letter right-factor closure, and probe direct-limit embedding and support lifting under a conservative base homomorphism, without right cancellation or injective transitions.

C_MONOID_REARRANGEMENT.statement: The same constructed T admits the asserted countable-base rearrangement with conservative successor operations and preserved gate rules.

C_MONOID_CONSTRUCTION.statement: Theorem monoid: the scheduled size-mu monoid T has clauses 1 through 4.

C_MONOID_DESCENT.statement: The alignment replacement hypotheses imply finite birth-ordinal descent into the initial countable submonoid.

C_COUNTABLE_GERMS.statement: In the ground model, the stabilizer quotient G_C/K_C is countable.

C_FORCING_SUPPORT.statement: The forcing and support construction gives all-rank presentations, ordinal-indexed choice, failure of wellorderability of A, and the required locality properties.

C_QUOTIENT_CLASSIFICATION.statement: Exact availability fibers and covariant choices assemble a hereditarily symmetric quotient bijection for every nonwellorderable image of A.

C_ALL_SET_REDUCTION.statement: The three hypotheses of the all-set reduction imply PP for every surjection in ZF.

C_CONSTRUCTION_SUMMARY.statement: The stated symmetric construction over a ZFC ground gives ZF+PP+ACwo+not AC with the asserted ordinal and sequence preservation.

C_METATHEORY.statement: The constructible consistency interpretation and symmetric forcing schema justify both the internal and evaluated model deductions.

C_MAIN_CONSISTENCY.statement: If ZF is consistent, then ZF+PP+ACwo+not AC is consistent.

C_MAIN_TRANSITIVE.statement: Every countable transitive ZFC ground has the stated transitive symmetric extension satisfying ZF+PP+ACwo+not AC.
